about: The defect register: every defect that can affect gain of function, one entry each (the operator's recovery directive of Oct 5, 2026, sections 4 and 5). The fields, the age rule and the state checks are described in Source/Python/mimo_bridge/tools/defect_register.py. Typed here: what the defect is, where it was read, who owns it, its cause status, its next action, what it waits on and its state. Computed on every read and not in this file: its age, its last meaningful work, the 12-hour and 24-hour rules and the checks of each typed state. Seeded on Oct 5, 2026 by the dashboard data-layer builder (branch dashboard/recovery-2026-10-05) from docs/H84_CHECKLIST_2026-10-04.html, docs/WELLNESS_QUOTES_REVIEW_2026-10-04.html, the directive, the contract of Oct 5 and the test registry; each entry lists its sources, and under 'unverified' what could not be read in them.
severity_rule: The directive names the four severities and does not define them. This register uses its section 3 sentence ('an open defect that blocks sensing, prediction, planning, control, or trustworthy measurement') and its section 3B item 3: GOF-BLOCKER = a measurement on the current model shows that it stands in the way of one of the scoreboard's stages (sensing, prediction, action causality, planner, intentional function); TRAINING-RISK = it can corrupt the training path without standing in the way of a stage today; MEASUREMENT-RISK = it can make a reading untrustworthy; NONBLOCKING = measured as not limiting, or listed by the checklist under its smaller items; CURRENT EFFECT UNKNOWN = a defect measured in the past whose effect on the current model is not measured: it becomes a GOF-BLOCKER when a direct measurement shows that it still damages a path prediction or planning needs, and it is closed as FAILED/SUPERSEDED with the evidence when the current model is shown to go around it (the operator, Oct 5, 2026). Every severity below is the builder's reading under this rule and is listed as unverified until the coordinator confirms it.
